name: single-language growth check
query: Is interest in 'intermittent fasting' growing on the English Wikipedia? Last 2 years.
expected_behavior: Runs search_article.ts for en, then fetch_pageviews.ts for the chosen article
Runs analyze_series.ts and plot_chart.ts on the results
States direction and percentChange from the metrics (not an invented number)
Names the selected article with a direct Wikipedia URL
States that pageviews reflect attention, not demand

name: multi-language comparison, no proxy substitution
query: Порівняй зростання інтересу до веб-розробки в польськомовній та чеськомовній Wikipedia за останні два роки.
expected_behavior: Uses one batch search call with --lang pl --lang cs
Selects an article per language independently
Does NOT substitute a related article (e.g. 'web design') for a missing direct one; skips the language instead
Compares direction and relative change across editions and does not compare absolute counts as audience size
Uses the last 24 complete months (ends at the previous month, not today)

name: optional PDF only after explicit confirmation
query: Проаналізуй інтерес до астрономії в україномовній Wikipedia за останні 2 роки
expected_behavior: Completes Steps 1-7 and writes the chat summary + shows the chart
Asks whether the user wants a PDF report
Does NOT create any PDF before the user confirms (no generate_report.ts call)
On confirmation: writes an English manifest matching the documented schema and runs generate_report.ts once
